hooks.name: pre-commit-check
hooks.description: Run typecheck, lint, and format check before commit

action.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check

hooks.name: post-task-pr-reminder
hooks.description: Remind to create PR after task completion

action.prompt: Task completed. Remember to: 1) Commit with conventional format, 2) Push to GitHub, 3) Create PR with task reference (Closes TASK-XXX). Use the PR template from .github/pull_request_template.md

hooks.name: validate-pr-branch
hooks.description: Ensure branch follows naming convention before push

action.command: git branch --show-current | grep -E '^(feat|fix|docs|refactor|test|chore)/' || echo 'WARNING: Branch name does not follow convention. Use feat/<name>, fix/<name>, docs/<name>, etc.'
